question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 H 组：沙特阿拉伯 vs 乌拉圭（90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group H: Saudi Arabia vs Uruguay (three-way result, 90 minutes)
one_liner_cn: 乌拉圭实力差距明显且阵容稳定齐整，沙特临阵换帅、热身赛多败，乌拉圭胜率约七成。
one_liner_en: Uruguay hold a clear strength edge with a settled squad while Saudi Arabia changed coaches weeks before the tournament; Uruguay win at roughly 70%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 316 分（乌拉圭 1892 vs 沙特 1576），统计模型给乌拉圭约 69% 基线胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 316-point Elo gap (Uruguay 1892 vs Saudi Arabia 1576) gives Uruguay a ~69% baseline win probability in the statistical model.

key_reasons.cn: 沙特 4 月底临阵换帅（Renard 下课、Donis 接任），距开赛不足两月，且近 5 场热身 2 胜 3 负。
key_reasons.en: Saudi Arabia replaced Renard with Donis in late April, under two months before kickoff, and went W2 L3 in their last five friendlies.

key_reasons.cn: 乌拉圭阵容齐整：Valverde 伤愈、Núñez 领衔锋线，近 5 场 4 场不败。
key_reasons.en: Uruguay are settled: Valverde recovered, Nunez leads the line, and the side is unbeaten in four of their last five.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gave 11.2/19.5/69.3; bounded evidence-based adjustment of ~2pp (cap 8pp) for Saudi coaching turmoil vs Uruguay stability, renormalized to 10/20/70. No betting or prediction-market data used.
